    Racing tips

    ROCKET STARTHold accelerate the moment the 2 appears. Too early and you stall.
    MINI-TURBODrift sparks go blue, then orange, then purple. Release on purple for the longest boost.
    TRICKSPress Space (or drift) while flying off a ramp to flip, and land it for a boost.
    BITCOINEach Bitcoin raises your top speed, up to 10. Getting hit drops three.
    OFF-ROADGrass and carpet slow you down unless you're boosting.
    FLYERSBombardiro Crocodilo flies over walls and water but is a little slower.
